methodology.events_total: count of occurred WSDC editions in event_editions.csv (result_rows > 0 or event_occurred); one row per event year/month that awarded points
methodology.points_total: sum of event_points across all nominations in dancers_results_info.csv
methodology.dancers_total: count of unique dancer_id in dancers_results_info.csv
methodology.dancers_increment: new dancers = unique dancer_id whose first WSDC points fall in the window (week/month: earliest edition start_date; year: event_year of that first event)
methodology.edition_dates: event_editions.csv start_date/end_date (edition_date remains YYYY-MM-01 for Tableau)
methodology.increment_note: Events/points increments count activity in the window. Dancers increment counts new dancers (first WSDC points), not unique participants.
methodology.week_note: Week uses ISO week of edition start_date for occurred events. Never advances to a week with no occurred events (e.g. Jul 13-19 empty → keep Jul 6-12). Baseline since_previous_ended is end of previous calendar month.
methodology.month_note: Month increment = occurred editions with start_date in the current month through as_of; new dancers with first points in that window.
methodology.year_note: Year increment uses WSDC event_year (not calendar start_date year), so late-December New Year events count toward the new year. Events = distinct event_name in results for that event_year; points = sum for those events; dancers = new dancers whose first points were at an event_year in this year.
